title: Eight states sue OpenAI, saying ChatGPT isn’t safe for kids
hook_text: Eight US states just sued OpenAI.
script:
Eight US states just sued OpenAI over ChatGPT child safety risks.
Iowa, Kansas, Nebraska, and West Virginia filed separate lawsuits against the company.
Arkansas, Arizona, Idaho, and Montana also joined the legal action.
The lawsuits accuse OpenAI of unlawfully prioritizing corporate profits over children's safety.
The state attorneys general claim the company misled customers regarding safety features.
The complaints demand civil penalties and injunctions to stop these misleading practices.
Will you let your kids use ChatGPT after this?
